title: Existence of the stalkwise tensor pairing
statement: For every scheme X there is a family t of maps on stalks whose values on represented germs equal the germ of moduleCup_sectionTensor applied to the sectionwise pure tensor.

proof.text: Represent two germs on a common neighbourhood and send them to the germ of the sectionwise tensor. Intersecting neighbourhoods and restriction compatibility show independence of representatives; bilinearity follows from the tensor construction.

theorem moduleCup_godement_tensor_stalk_pairing_exists (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ t : ∀ (H K : X.Modules) (x : X),
      H.presheaf.stalk x → K.presheaf.stalk x → (H ⊗ K).presheaf.stalk x,
    ∀ (H K : X.Modules) (x : X) (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U)
        (s : Γ(H, U)) (r : Γ(K, U)),
      t H K x (H.presheaf.germ U x hx s) (K.presheaf.germ U x hx r) =
        (H ⊗ K).presheaf.germ U x hx
          ((moduleCup_sectionTensor X H K).app (op U)
            (s ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, U)] r))
